<thought>Using the mass spectrum, the main peak at m/z ≈ 199 shows a characteristic Br isotopic pattern (M and M+2 of similar intensity), indicating one bromine atom. Assuming the peak is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is ≈ 197.99 Da. The monoisotopic composition that matches this mass is C₅H₁₁O₃Br, which gives a calculated neutral mass of 197.988 Da (within experimental error) and a DBE of 0, consistent with a saturated brominated organic molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H11O3Br</final_answer>
